extraction_limitations: Extraction is grounded in the supplied 18-page preprint, including main-text tables/figures and appendices; no external verification was performed because @SOURCE-ONLY was not requested and no verification was necessary for extraction.

The LiteratureAtom schema has clinical-style population/exposure/outcome context. For AI/ML quantitative results, population labels represent evaluation sets, exposures represent model/method conditions, and outcomes represent benchmark metrics.

Many table rows report multiple metrics, while QuantitativeResult has one primary estimate. Each row-level atom stores the principal metric in estimate and preserves secondary reported metrics in canonical_statement and/or original_result_text.
No funding disclosure or conflict-of-interest statement was located in the supplied paper text; no atom was fabricated for those fields.
All atoms are marked needs_review because they were extracted by a language model and have not been independently human-verified.
